_README: Christine's sold homes, as plotted on /sold-homes-map.html.
THIS IS THE ONLY FILE YOU NEED TO EDIT TO ADD A PIN TO THE MAP.
Run `python3 build/build.py` afterward, then commit and push. The build
regenerates both the page and the copy the Netlify geocoder function reads
(netlify/functions/lib/_sold-homes-data.json), so the two can no longer
drift apart the way they used to.
A VIDEO IS OPTIONAL. This is the whole point of this file: before
2026-08-14 the map was built only from the sold-status entries in
_LISTING_VIDEO_ENTRIES in build.py, which meant a home only got a pin if
Christine had also filmed a YouTube tour for it. That capped the map at 12
pins out of 150+ real sales. Now the minimum entry is just an address and
a city:
{ "address": "1234 Example St", "city": "Loveland" }
Fields:
address  (required) street address, no city -- e.g. "32 Victoria Dr"
city     (required) town only, no state -- e.g. "Johnstown". This
matters: without it the Geocoding API guesses between
same-named streets in different towns and drops the pin in the
wrong place.
state    (optional) defaults to CO
year     (optional) year sold, shown in the pin popup when present
videoId  (optional) YouTube ID -- adds the clickable tour to the popup
title    (optional) video title, used as the link's accessible label
Only list homes Christine actually represented. These are her own past
sales, published by her -- deliberately NOT pulled from the MLS feed,
which excludes Sold/Closed status entirely on purpose (see
REPLICATED_STATUSES in netlify/functions/lib/_mls-shared.js).
2026-08-15: 14 addresses added from Christine's own sold-listings page.
Deliberately address + city + year only -- NOT the price, beds, or square
footage that page displays alongside them. Those figures come out of the IRES
IDX feed, whose own notice on that page limits the data to consumers'
personal, non-commercial use. Her transaction history is hers to publish; the
MLS's listing content is not, and the map does not need it.
Two exclusions from that page, both on purpose:
- 2411 Glade Rd, Loveland: this is Christine's own business address (see
SITE['address'] in build.py). It appears as a real 2025 sale, but putting
her own address on a public map is her call to make, not a default.
- 1598 Carriage Dr, Eaton was listed twice under two MLS numbers
(1048702 and 7428613). Added once.
2026-08-15 (pages 2-3 of the same source): the full sold list on that page is
48 records. Everything with a street address is now here. Two records were
deliberately not added:
- a 35-acre unimproved parcel in Nunn (sold Jul 2024) whose address the MLS
itself lists as unavailable -- there is nothing to geocode.
- 2411 Glade Rd, Loveland (Christine's own business address), noted above.
Two addresses already in this file were CORRECTED against the MLS record,
because they had been taken from YouTube video titles typed by hand:
5705 Snow Mesa Dr -> 5705 Snow Mesa Ct  (Loveland)
4986 Stuart St    -> 4869 Stuart St     (Denver; digit transposition, and
4986 W 5th St in Greeley is a real
separate sale, which is probably
where the wrong number came from)
Both keep their video tours. If either correction is wrong, the video title is
the thing to re-check, not the MLS.

2026-08-16: eight pins removed. They came from the sold-status inference in _LISTING_VIDEO_ENTRIES (build.py) -- 'absent from her live-listings sheet, so presumably closed' -- not from Christine's records. She confirmed 32 Victoria Dr and 475 Homestead Ln did NOT sell, which invalidated the other six by the same reasoning. A pin belongs here only when Christine's own records back it, which in practice means it carries a year. Removed: 1110 S Quitman St, 1316 Cimarron Cir, 294 Gila Trail, 32 Victoria Dr, 39243 Boulevard E, 45615 County Rd 27, 475 Homestead Ln, 929 W Independent Ave.

2026-08-16, same day: 1110 S Quitman St went back in. It was one of the eight removed above, and then her own 'Bold Collective — Updated Deal Tracker' in Drive turned out to record it CLOSED on 06/05/2026 at $405,000, co-listed with Kendra. That is a document, which is the standard -- one of the six unconfirmed addresses cleared it and five did not.

2026-08-16, third correction of the day and the one that came straight from Christine: "i sold 294 gila, bold 3 rounty rd 27 not indpendevent or cimaron". So 294 Gila Trail (Ault), 39243 Boulevard E (Eaton) and 45615 County Rd 27 (Pierce) go back in, and 929 W Independent Ave and 1316 Cimarron Cir are recorded not-sold. No year on these three -- she has confirmed the sale, which is the standard here; the year is not required for a pin and is not shown when absent.
